Gate.dealerJudged: the creature dealing the damage is judged by you
Gate.victimJudged: the damaged creature is judged by you
Gate.victimMarked: the damaged creature is marked by you
Gate.typedDamage: the damage is not untyped or holy
Gate.surged: the damage used 1 or more surges
Gate.lineOfEffect: the creature is within your line of effect
Gate.threeHeroes: three or more heroes used an ability this turn

MultiplierOverride.Name: Multiplier Override
MultiplierOverride.Hint: Halving and doubling pills always apply after plus and minus bonuses, and sort to the right of them to reflect the order.

NoMultiplierStacking.Name: No Multiplier Stacking
NoMultiplierStacking.Hint: Multiple halving or multiple doubling pills do not stack; duplicates beyond the first have no effect and show as inactive.

PillDamageEditor.Name: Pill Damage Editor
PillDamageEditor.Hint: Replaces Draw Steel Target Damage's edit damage dialog with the pill window, where halves, doubles, custom amounts and surges each show as a named pill. Turn off to use the original editor.

ResolutionHolds.Name: Post-Roll Resolution Holds
ResolutionHolds.Hint: When a creature has a trigger that answers a strike's roll, such as a retroactive bane, the strike's damage and effects wait on the stack until the trigger is decided.

DebugMode.Name: Debug Mode
DebugMode.Hint: Log trigger detection details to the console.

ChatReminders.Name: Chat Reminders
ChatReminders.Hint: Whisper a reminder to an ability's owner when its trigger condition may have occurred.

CombatOnly.Name: Only Trigger During Active Combat
CombatOnly.Hint: Triggers are only checked if there is an active combat on the activated scene.

AllSceneTokens.Name: All Scene Tokens Can Trigger
AllSceneTokens.Hint: Every token on the scene can trigger its triggers regardless of if it's in combat or not.

RequireLineOfEffect.Name: Require Line of Effect
RequireLineOfEffect.Hint: A trigger that reaches another creature also needs line of effect to it, as targeting does. Turn off to check distance only.

SpentTracking.Name: Track Triggered Actions
SpentTracking.Hint: Track when a combatant spends their triggered action and stop reminding them about non-free triggers until the next round.

TurnInterrupts.Name: Turn Interrupts
TurnInterrupts.Hint: Hold a creature's activation while triggered abilities that can take the turn instead, such as Prescient Grace, Hesitation is Weakness, Fulfill Your Destiny or Time Loop, wait for a Use or Decline decision. Only applies during combat.

OfferVillainActions.Name: Offer Villain Actions
OfferVillainActions.Hint: When a hero's turn ends, offer the Director the villain actions each standing villain has not used yet, and hold the turn until they choose. Each one is offered once per combat, and a villain that has used one waits for the next round.

FeatureTriggers.Name: Feature Triggers
FeatureTriggers.Hint: Triggers written into hero features, ancestry traits, titles, perks, complications and treasures. A coin before each line opens it in the trigger builder.

DerivedTriggers.Name: Derived Trigger Abilities
DerivedTriggers.Hint: Each trigger found in a feature becomes its own triggered ability on the actor, listed with the others. Edit one to correct it; delete one to ignore that trigger.

AutoSpendConsumables.Name: Spend Consumables Automatically
AutoSpendConsumables.Hint: Using a trigger from a consumable takes one from its stack straight away, instead of asking with a button. A consumable with none left stops triggering either way.

DerivedChatLinks.Name: Link Derived Triggers in Chat
DerivedChatLinks.Hint: An ability's chat card shows each trigger that became its own ability as a link to it, instead of the trigger's full text. Abilities only.

FeatureShareCards.Name: Feature Cards on Share
FeatureShareCards.Hint: Share on a feature, perk, ancestry trait or complication posts a card shaped like an ability, with buttons for its gains, damage, conditions and rolls.

BasicMalice.Name: Add Basic Malice Features
BasicMalice.Hint: Monsters that join a combat get Brutal Effectiveness and Malicious Strike on their sheet, the two Malice features every monster can use.

FeatureIgnore.Name: Ignored Features
FeatureIgnore.Hint: Features that never get feature triggers. Click a feature to stop ignoring it. The Ignore button in a feature's trigger builder adds to this list too.

ResourceGains.Name: Heroic Resource Gains
ResourceGains.Hint: Heroic resource gains written in each hero's features, such as a Fury taking damage. Gain them automatically, or offer each one on the Trigger Stack for the player to use or decline.

ResourcesUiSync.Name: Resources UI Sync
ResourcesUiSync.Hint: Mark each gain as used in Draw Steel - Resources UI, and let its undo button take a gain back.

RosterGains.Name: Resource Gains in the Trigger List
RosterGains.Hint: List each hero's heroic resource gains in the Trigger Stack's trigger list, so you can snooze them like any other trigger.

RollLock.Name: Roll Lock
RollLock.Hint: Hold ability rolls while triggered abilities that could interrupt them wait for a Use or Decline decision. Only applies during combat.

DamagePrompts.Name: Damage Prompts
DamagePrompts.Hint: When a creature takes damage, dies, or becomes winded, matching triggered abilities appear in the Trigger Stack with Use and Decline instead of a chat reminder.

ConditionPrompts.Name: Condition Prompts
ConditionPrompts.Hint: When a creature gains a condition, an effect on it ends, or a grab is broken, matching triggered abilities appear in the Trigger Stack with Use and Decline instead of a chat reminder.

FreeStrikeCards.Name: Free Strike Messages
FreeStrikeCards.Hint: A monster's Free Strike posts its damage to chat as that monster, so it's applied from the chat message and triggers know who struck.

DamageInterrupts.Name: Damage Interrupts
DamageInterrupts.Hint: Hold incoming damage before it lands when the target or an ally has a triggered ability that modifies it, such as halving. The Director confirms the final amount after triggers resolve. Only applies during combat.

HoldInertTriggers.Name: Hold Every Post-Roll Trigger
HoldInertTriggers.Hint: Also hold the strike for triggers that do not change it, such as Ram's Defiance, so a creature can act before a killing blow lands. Off, those are offered without holding the strike. Triggers that change the strike always hold.

FmInterrupts.Name: Forced Movement Interrupts
FmInterrupts.Hint: Hold forced movement before it starts while a trigger that can reduce, boost or redirect it, such as Lines of Force or Repel, waits for a decision.

SkipEmptyDialogs.Name: Skip Empty Ability Dialogs
SkipEmptyDialogs.Hint: Using a trigger from the stack skips the ability's dialog when it has no power roll, no resource to spend and no damage type to pick.

AutoUseMandatory.Name: Automatically Use Mandatory Costless Triggers
AutoUseMandatory.Hint: Triggers that always happen and cost nothing, such as damage bonuses and changes to forced movement or falls, apply on their own. When off, they wait on the Trigger Stack like any other.

AutoUseTriggers.Name: Automatically Use All Costless Triggers
AutoUseTriggers.Hint: Also uses optional triggers that cost nothing the moment they reach the stack. Needs the setting above. Triggered actions and once per round triggers still wait.

StackDecisionTimer.Name: Stack Decision Timer
StackDecisionTimer.Hint: Triggers on the stack auto-decline after the Roll Lock Grace Period elapses with no decision. Choosing Use grants the rest of the group fresh time.

RollLockGrace.Name: Roll Lock Grace Period
RollLockGrace.Hint: After Use is chosen, the held roll resumes once the triggered ability posts, or after this many seconds if it never does.

Mode.resolution: holds the resolution after the roll

Detail.ScopeNeedsTier: Scope {scope}: needs a compatibility tier to resolve.

Detail.TargetedHalf: Halves on use: using this from a roll lock pre-halves the incoming damage.
Detail.RollModifying: Roll modifying: using this applies {effect} to the triggering roll.
Detail.Redirect: Redirects on use: the triggering strike is retargeted {mode}.
Detail.Revisit: Marked for a later revisit; not detected yet.
Detail.EffectTodo: Detected and held at the right moment, but its effect still needs applying by hand.

Editor.OpenTooltip: Open the trigger builder to override how this trigger is automated.
Editor.NoTriggerText: This ability has no trigger text.

TriggerPill.event: Clause {n}: what happens. Click to show its event.

Editor.RedirectSwap: Owner becomes the target and switches places

EventDesc.TAKES_DAMAGE: A creature loses Stamina to damage. Not a Stamina loss from bleeding, which is not damage. Prompts on the stack after the damage lands.
EventDesc.WOULD_TAKE_DAMAGE: Damage is about to land on a creature. The damage is held until the triggers resolve.
EventDesc.DEALS_DAMAGE: A creature deals damage to another creature. Reminder only for now.
EventDesc.DIES: A creature dies: a hero at the negative of their winded value, anyone else at 0 Stamina. Prompts on the stack.
EventDesc.WINDED: A creature becomes winded. Prompts on the stack.
EventDesc.DYING: A hero drops to 0 Stamina and is dying. Prompts on the stack.
EventDesc.WINDED_OR_DYING: A creature becomes winded, or a hero becomes dying. Prompts on the stack.
EventDesc.TARGETED_BY_STRIKE: A strike targets the watched creature. Locks the roll until decided.
EventDesc.TARGETED_BY_ABILITY: Any ability targets the watched creature, strike or not. Locks the roll until decided.
EventDesc.MAKES_STRIKE: A creature makes a strike. Locks the roll until decided.
EventDesc.POWER_ROLL: A creature makes a power roll. Locks the roll until decided.
EventDesc.MOVES: A creature moves, shifts, or leaves a square. Needs the Combat Tools tier.
EventDesc.FORCE_MOVED: A creature is pushed, pulled, or slid. Needs the Combat Tools tier.
EventDesc.FORCE_MOVES: A creature pushes, pulls, or slides someone else. Fires after the move. Needs the Combat Tools tier.
EventDesc.FALL_START: A creature starts to fall. The fall waits until the triggers are decided. Needs the Combat Tools tier.
EventDesc.HERO_TOKEN_EARNED: The party earns a hero token. The start-of-session reset does not count.
EventDesc.TURN_START: A creature's turn begins. Chat reminder, or holds the activation for abilities that take the turn.
EventDesc.TURN_END: A creature's turn ends. Chat reminder, or holds the next activation for abilities that take the turn.
EventDesc.ROUND_START: A new combat round begins. Chat reminder.
EventDesc.CONDITION_GAIN: A creature gains a condition such as bleeding or prone, or an effect that ends on a save or at turn end. Prompts on the stack.
EventDesc.USES_ABILITY: A creature uses an ability, action, or maneuver. Not detected yet.
EventDesc.POWER_ROLL_RESULT: A specific power roll outcome, like tier 1 or a critical. Not detected yet.
EventDesc.ZONE_ENTER: A creature enters a linked zone or area. Not detected yet.
EventDesc.ZONE_TURN_START: A creature starts its turn inside a linked zone. Not detected yet.
EventDesc.EFFECT_ENDS: A named effect on a creature ends. Prompts on the stack.
EventDesc.SAVING_THROW: A creature makes a saving throw. Not detected yet.
EventDesc.REGAINS_STAMINA: A creature regains Stamina. Chat reminder.
EventDesc.LOSES_STAMINA: A creature loses Stamina for any reason, damage or otherwise. Use this rather than Takes Damage for something that reacts to bleeding. Chat reminder.
EventDesc.MARKED: The watched creature is marked. Needs Draw Steel: Combat Tools data.
EventDesc.RESOURCE_GAIN: A creature gains a heroic resource. Special case abilities only.
EventDesc.STAMINA_BELOW: Stamina falls below a set threshold. Prompts on the stack.
EventDesc.MECHANISM: A siege engine or mechanism is operated. Special case abilities only.
EventDesc.NARRATIVE: A narrative moment the Director calls for. Never automated.
EventDesc.GRAB_ENDS: A grab held by the watched creature ends. Prompts on the stack. Combat Tools tier.
EventDesc.RESISTS_POTENCY: An ability with a potency targets a creature, which must resist it.
EventDesc.TEST_FAILED: An ally fails a test. Special case abilities only.
EventDesc.UNKNOWN: The parser could not classify this trigger. Reminder only.

Editor.ScopeHint: Who the event must happen to, from this ability's owner's point of view.
Editor.RangeHint: How close the triggering creature must be to this ability's owner. Ability distance uses the range printed on the ability, such as Melee 1.
Editor.QualifiersHint: Each pill is one qualifier, coloured by where it came from: the trigger text, the effect text, a hand-written special case, or your own change. Click a pill to view or change it, or + to add one.
Editor.MaliceHint: Malice actions are offered to the Director on the acting creature's turn and never spend a triggered action.
Editor.SaveHint: Stores this configuration on the ability and stops using the automatic parser.
Editor.ResetHint: Deletes the override and returns this ability to the automatic parser.
Editor.RedirectFlanker: The creature flanking the owner becomes the target
Editor.TimingAfter: After the roll: holds the results
Editor.TimingHint: Before the roll, the trigger can change the roll or retarget the strike. After the roll, it fires once the result is known and holds the damage and effects while the owner decides.
Editor.NoImpacts: Nothing happens automatically when this trigger is used. Add an impact with the + above.
Editor.NoImpactsPossible: None of this trigger's events support an automatic impact yet. Using it from the stack still posts the ability.

Impact.Unsupported: Clause {n}'s event can't use this, so saving drops it.

hold.Label: Hold the Damage
hold.Hint: The damage waits before it lands while the owner decides, so other impacts can change it. Without this, the trigger only prompts after the damage applies.

halfHeld.Label: Halve the Held Damage
halfHeld.Hint: Using the trigger halves the held damage in the final amount window.

reduceHeld.Label: Reduce the Held Damage
reduceHeld.Hint: Using the trigger subtracts this from the held damage.

redirectHeld.Label: Redirect the Held Damage
redirectHeld.Allies: Only the owner or an ally
redirectHeld.Hint: Using the trigger moves the held damage onto another creature.

halfStrike.Label: Halve the Strike's Damage
halfStrike.Before: Halves the damage this creature takes
halfStrike.After: Halves the damage for the struck target
halfStrike.Hint: Using the trigger halves the triggering strike's damage. Before the roll it halves the damage buttons for this creature; after the roll, for the struck target.

rollMod.Label: Change the Roll
rollMod.PerTargetHint: When the roll has several targets, only the one that set off the trigger changes.
rollMod.Hint: Using the trigger changes the triggering power roll. Before the roll it goes into the roll dialog; after the roll the tier is worked out again for the struck target.

redirect.Label: Redirect the Strike
redirect.ReflectHalf: The reflected strike deals half damage
redirect.Allies: Only the owner or an ally
redirect.Hint: Using the trigger retargets the triggering strike. Self and reflect apply on their own before the roll; the others need a pick or a manual follow-up.

fmMod.Label: Change the Forced Movement
fmMod.Mode_redirect: The owner takes over the movement
fmMod.Mode_objectDamage: Extra damage on hitting an object
fmMod.PerSurgeHint: 0 applies it once. Above 0, the owner spends up to this many surges and the change counts once for each.
fmMod.Hint: Using the trigger changes the forced movement before it happens.

fallReduce.Label: Shorten the Fall
fallReduce.Hint: Using the trigger lowers the height of the fall.

fallSafe.Label: Land Safely
fallSafe.Hint: Using the trigger makes the fall deal no damage.

fallCancel.Label: Stop the Fall
fallCancel.Hint: Using the trigger cancels the fall, as long as the owner can still move.

damageBonus.Label: Damage Bonus
damageBonus.SummaryOptional: +{n} damage, if you turn it on
damageBonus.OptionalHint: The damage card shows it switched off, for the player to turn on.
damageBonus.TypeHint: A type other than the ability's own becomes its own damage row on the card, so immunities and weaknesses apply to it separately.
damageBonus.VsHint: Uses a different amount when the creature hit has this keyword.
damageBonus.Hint: Adds this much damage on its own whenever the trigger matches, without asking.

damageType.Label: Change the Damage Type
damageType.Hint: Adds a switched-off damage type pill to each target of the triggering ability; turn it on to deal that type instead.

markVictim.Label: Mark the Victim
markVictim.Hint: Marks the creature that took the damage, on its own whenever the trigger matches.

markDealer.Label: Mark Whoever Dealt It
markDealer.Hint: Copies this effect from the trigger's item onto the creature that dealt the damage, until the end of the owner's next turn.

turn.Label: Take the Turn
turn.bonusTurn: A bonus turn that doesn't use an activation
turn.manualTurn: The Director puts the turn back by hand
turn.Hint: The activation waits while the owner decides. Using the trigger lets the owner take the turn instead.

gain.Label: Gain Heroic Resource
gain.Hint: Using the trigger adds this to the hero's heroic resource. Dice such as 1d3 are rolled.

cost.Label: Resource Cost
cost.Hint: Using the trigger spends this. It isn't offered while the owner can't pay.

defersDeath.Label: Delay Death
defersDeath.Hint: Using the trigger delays the hero's death, as the effect text describes.

consumable.Label: Use Up a Consumable
consumable.Manual: Offers a Use One button in chat
consumable.Hint: Using the trigger uses one of the consumable it comes from. Spend Consumables Automatically in the settings decides whether that happens on its own.

Impact.EffectHint: Pills mark the words each impact was read from, coloured by where it came from. Select any words to link them to an impact yourself.
Impact.NothingToLink: Add an impact first, then link words to it.

enhanced.Hint: Added by Combat Tools' Enhanced Features: a button on the ability's chat card when it is used. Edit it on the ability's Impact tab in the item sheet.

Editor.RangeOwnerInAbility: This creature is within the triggering ability's distance
Editor.HowOftenHint: A limit on how often this trigger can be used.

Option.subject: The creature the event happens to
Option.save-or-eot: Ends on a save or at the end of its turn

ownerEffectOn.subject: The creature the event happens to

creatureIs.Label: The creature is
creatureIs.Hint: A creature in the event must be, or must not be, a certain kind of creature. Turn on each rule that applies.
creatureIs.Examples: Fulfill Your Destiny (the subject is a hero), Time Loop (not this creature), Feast (not a minion), Exploit Opening (has a keyword), Do Not Hesitate in the Wode (this creature is its squad's captain), Abyssal Protectors (the last minion of its squad)

Rule.notSelf: The subject is not this creature
Rule.victimNotSelf: The creature hit is not this creature
Rule.groupName: The subject has this keyword, or the word in its name
Rule.organization: The subject is not one of these organizations
Rule.victimNotMentor: The subject is not this retainer's mentor
Rule.captainOnly: This creature is its squad's captain
Rule.lastMinion: The subject is the last minion of its squad

recoveryByOwner.Label: Recovery this creature allowed
recoveryByOwner.Hint: Only a Recovery spent because this creature let them spend it.

Rule.recoveryByOwner: Only a Recovery this creature allowed

disposition.Label: Another creature's disposition
disposition.Hint: Another creature in the event must have a certain Token Disposition, compared with this creature's or as a fixed value. A token with the same disposition as this creature counts as an ally.
disposition.Examples: Brawny Buffer (an ally attacks), Shared Sickness (an enemy is hit), Provoking Nettles (moving through an enemy), Command (you or an ally attacks)

lineOfEffect.Label: Line of effect
lineOfEffect.Hint: This creature must have line of effect to the creature the trigger names, even with Require Line of Effect off.

flankedByDealer.Label: While flanked
flankedByDealer.Hint: Only while the attacker is flanking this creature.

Rule.flankedByDealer: The attacker is flanking this creature

highGround.Label: From high ground
highGround.Hint: Only against a creature this creature has high ground over.

Rule.highGround: This creature has high ground over the creature hit

subjectConcealed.Label: While concealed
subjectConcealed.Hint: Only while the creature has concealment or is invisible.

Rule.subjectConcealed: The subject is concealed or invisible

zone.Label: In a named area
zone.Hint: Only in that area or terrain, such as the lava or a frozen pond.
zone.Examples: Liquid Hot Magma, Slippery Surface, Sticky Stakes

ability.Label: The ability used
ability.Hint: The ability that set the trigger off must match every rule you turn on. Anything left off is not checked.
ability.Examples: Lash Out (a melee ability), Growing Ferocity (a heroic ability), Harmonize (costs at most 1, exactly one target), Horn Toss (a specific ability), Orc Rampart's No. (not if it also targets this creature), Master of Reels (does not force move)

Rule.abilityKeywordsAll: Needs all of the keywords, not just one
Rule.abilityCostScales: This creature can pay for it
Rule.abilityPotency: Has a potency on one of its tiers
Rule.excludeSelfTarget: Does not also target this creature
Rule.rolledDamage: Its damage comes from a power roll
Rule.abilityDealsDamage: It deals damage (power roll, damage button or damage link)

roll.Label: The roll
roll.Hint: Rules about the power roll that set the trigger off.
roll.Examples: Acquired Taste (an edge or a spent surge), Turnabout Is Fair Play (an edge or a bane), Courtesy Call (a tier 3 outcome), Words Become Wonders at Next Breath (this creature's own roll counts)

Rule.rollHas: The roll has, after edges and banes cancel out

damage.Label: The damage
damage.Hint: Rules about the damage that set the trigger off.
damage.Examples: Fire Bad (fire damage), Death Strike (makes them winded), Word of Fate Denied (would leave them dying), Elemental Buffer (stopped by immunity), Ease Their Fall (from falling), Inertial Sink (from forced movement)

Rule.reducedByImmunity: Stopped by this creature's damage immunity

hasEffect.Label: Has an effect
hasEffect.Hint: A creature must have, or must not have, a condition or effect. Choose who carries it, which effect it is, and who applied it. Effects from abilities and features match by their Draw Steel ID, so every creature's copy counts.
hasEffect.Examples: Warmaster (judged by you), Ether-Fueled Vessel (insubstantial to you), Slake My Thirst in Blood (a bleeding target), Wrathful Spirit (while you are not frightened), Knocking Heads (you grab a creature)

Rule.ownerEffect: Carries this creature's effect (read from the trigger)
Rule.tauntedByOwner: The subject is taunted by this creature
Rule.throughMark: The creature moved through is insubstantial to this creature
Rule.victimCondition: The creature hit has this condition
Rule.ownerLacks: This creature does not have this condition

which.Label: Which condition or effect
which.Hint: For the events about a condition being gained or an effect ending: which one it must be, and how it ends.
which.Examples: Blood For Blood (a condition), Prickly Situation (a named effect ends), Quick Shield (ends on a save or at turn end)

Short.durationFilter: ends on a save or turn end

grabbing.Label: This creature is grabbing
grabbing.Hint: This creature must be holding creatures grabbed.
grabbing.Examples: Knocking Heads (at least two), Foes as Weapons (one its size or smaller)

Rule.ownerGrabbing: Holding one its size or smaller

movement.Label: The movement
movement.Hint: Rules about how a creature moved.
movement.Examples: Boren (a push or a slide that ends next to you), Provoking Nettles (moves through a space), Flying Circus (moves adjacent), Death Grasp (enters this space), Absorbed Impact (even if resisted)

Rule.through: Passes through another creature's space, once for each
Rule.arrives: Ends a move adjacent to this creature, and was not there already
Rule.victimEndsAdjacent: The moved creature ends adjacent to
Rule.fmPowerRoll: The movement comes from a power roll
Rule.entersSpace: Enters the square this creature died in, once
Rule.evenIfResisted: Counts even when stability stops the movement

acted.Label: Who has acted
acted.Hint: Rules about turn order in the round.
acted.Examples: Hesitation is Weakness (before this creature acts), Prescient Grace (while a hero has not acted), Allow Me to Introduce Tonight's Players (first turn of combat)

Rule.ownerUnacted: This creature has not acted yet this round
Rule.anyHeroUnacted: A hero has not acted yet this round
Rule.firstTurn: The creature's first turn of the combat

Short.anyHeroUnacted: while a hero has not acted

value.Label: Stamina drops below
value.Hint: Fires when the creature's Stamina drops below this number.
